newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's end-Sept palm oil stock 894,030 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's end-Sept palm oil stock 894,030 tonnes.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks rose 11.33 percent to 894,030 tonnes at end-September from 803,016 at end-August and compared with 646,269 tonnes at end-September 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Tuesday.

Stocks of crude palm oil were 524,511 tonnes, against 474,313 at end-August and 358,149 a year earlier. Processed palm oil stocks totalled 369,519 tonnes compared with 328,703 and 288,120 respectively, PORLA said.

Stocks of crude palm kernel oil were 63,863 tonnes at end-September against 53,353 at end-August and 38,125 at end-September 1995. Processed palm kernel oil stocks were 53,904 tonnes compared with 48,557 and 42,348 respectively.
